SXR-AUD-001.decision: Audit the decoded stored values with the cleaner's structured detector, once per physical record. Tool display summaries no longer determine coverage.
SXR-AUD-001.title: Secret audit misses credentials in Write tool contents

SXR-AUD-002.decision: Compare UTC datetime values, including offset and fractional boundaries. A missing or invalid session start cannot establish membership in a bounded window.
SXR-AUD-002.title: Time filters compare timestamp strings instead of instants

SXR-AUD-003.decision: Preserve isApiErrorMessage on error-bearing events without assigning a tool call a false outcome. Multiple text blocks emit their original JSON record once. Invalidate older read-position snapshots.
SXR-AUD-003.title: Counted Claude API errors disappear from the errors view

SXR-AUD-004.decision: Use the same SQLite unicode61 tokenizer for finding the excerpt location as for retrieval. Cut the original string at source offsets.
SXR-AUD-004.title: Normalized find matches can produce excerpts with no matching text

SXR-AUD-005.decision: Limit complete distinct physical JSON records in show, prompts and errors. Omission counts go to stderr.
SXR-AUD-005.title: show, prompts and errors ignore row limits in JSON mode

SXR-AUD-006.decision: Share the errors row allowance across selected sessions and report the full omitted count in both formats.
SXR-AUD-006.title: errors applies text limits per session and hides omissions

SXR-AUD-007.decision: Apply -n to tool rows, stat rows, paths and cleaning report rows. JSON aggregate objects retain all fields. A cleaning report limit never changes which selected files are scanned or rewritten.
SXR-AUD-007.title: tools, stats, path and clean accept but ignore -n

SXR-AUD-008.decision: Full views bypass the character budget while retaining row limits and complete selected text.
SXR-AUD-008.title: --full still trims long transcript text

SXR-AUD-009.decision: Attach each Claude tool input to its own event and count only that Skill call, excluding unrelated tools.
SXR-AUD-009.title: Skill input counts multiply when calls share a record

SXR-AUD-010.decision: Empty show selections return 1 in both text and JSON, with and without the read cache.
SXR-AUD-010.title: Empty show selections exit successfully only in text mode

SXR-AUD-011.decision: Choose zero selected events for --tail 0, with empty-result exit 1. Negative tails are usage errors. This is distinct from the documented unlimited -n 0.
SXR-AUD-011.title: --tail 0 returns the entire selected transcript

SXR-AUD-012.decision: Reject negative row limits before discovery in the shared Typer option. Existing fast find and skills validation agrees. Root, group and command flag positions retain the same rule.
SXR-AUD-012.title: Negative row limits are accepted inconsistently

SXR-AUD-013.decision: Path JSON emits path objects. Clean JSON emits masked file-result objects with applied state, counts and kinds. Diagnostics and totals remain on stderr.
SXR-AUD-013.title: path and secrets clean accept --json but emit plain text

SXR-AUD-014.decision: Compute all distinct-secret and severity totals before slicing. Limited and unlimited output retain the same fingerprints.
SXR-AUD-014.title: Limited secret worklists understate the number of findings

SXR-AUD-015.decision: Skip non-object JSONL records like malformed syntax, in both providers and index parsing. Later valid records retain physical line numbers. Files are not rewritten.
SXR-AUD-015.title: A non-object JSONL record crashes transcript reads

SXR-AUD-016.decision: Catch filesystem and text-decoding failures at the init command boundary, name the destination and return 2. Preserve existing files on denied access.
SXR-AUD-016.title: Primer filesystem failures escape as Python tracebacks

SXR-AUD-017.decision: Keep the deliberate successful empty listing for compatibility. State the exception in README, top-level help and generated primer.
SXR-AUD-017.title: The documented empty-result exit code omits the list exception
